value.rationale: At fixed density two, the full regular/nonregular two-coset transition for a natural odd rational window is classified, including all irrational shifts; sharp degeneration makes the spectral stability loss quantitative. The three-point Zak-zero calculation is a motivated nontrivial structural ingredient, and the half-shift obstruction is opposite to the previously studied even Poisson window. This gives a genuine window-dependent boundary phenomenon, beyond a negative special case or a routine renaming of a lattice parameter.
